Acme Soda unveils limited edition holiday cans

Published 2026-11-02

Acme Soda is rolling out limited edition holiday cans in all 50 states this month. The new cans feature winter artwork and will be sold at grocery stores, convenience stores, and online.

The limited edition run includes three new flavors: Cranberry Fizz, Ginger Snap, and Peppermint Pop. Each can asks shoppers to sign up for the Acme Rewards program to earn points toward free drinks.

The holiday cans will be on shelves from November 10 through January 15, 2027, according to the company announcement shared with retailers nationwide.
